_comment: lean.notify config (python -m lean.notify --config). Unknown keys are refused. No secrets here: they live in the telegram.json / provider-keys.json systemd credentials. mode is the tag on every message (PAPER or LIVE). Times are local to timezone. quiet_hours null = off; during quiet hours BUY/SELL are batched into one digest sent when they end (HALT is always immediate). allowed_chat_ids null = only the telegram.json chat_id may use /status /today /pnl. daily_summary_at null = no daily summary.
